title: Fri 30 Oct 2026: Binance's $6.3B theft, Canadian law firms breached, GitLab and Cisco enter KEV, plus the week in review
description: Binance loses about $6.3B (TRM attributes it to North Korea's TraderTraitor); McCarthy Tétrault and Davies breached via social engineering as Canada warns of help-desk vishing; Silent Ransom Group lists Susman Godfrey; CISA adds GitLab and Cisco ASA/FTD to KEV (due 1 Nov); commissary freezer failures probed as a cyberattack. Resolved: the two Arista VeloCloud CVEs are different flaws. Deep dive: TraderTraitor and Binance. Weekly roll-up for Fri 23 to Thu 29 Oct.
